board1.lead: A speculative autonomous platform that supports calmer, more visible debris recovery in protected harbor infrastructure.

cards.title: Gentle intake
cards.body: A central mesh channel gives the recovery process one clear, readable direction.

cards.title: Visible service
cards.body: Four removable cartridges make collection and unloading legible within a civic workflow.

cards.title: Harbor fit
cards.body: Compact catamaran geometry keeps the system visually calm around public waterfront space.

insights: Waterfront maintenance should remain understandable to the public.
Marine equipment needs robust surfaces without visual noise.
Product, dock, and workflow should share one service language.

modules.title: Central mesh intake
modules.body: A protected channel concentrates the visible recovery path in the center of the platform.

modules.title: Collection cartridge array
modules.body: Four translucent modules communicate removable storage and a clear service rhythm.

modules.title: Twin side propulsion pods
modules.body: Compact side pods maintain a balanced, low-profile marine stance.

notes: All workflow and data elements are conceptual communication devices.
No environmental or operational performance is asserted by this concept.
